SELECT TOP (#{pg} * #{pgCnt}) RTRIM(IC.품목코드) AS IC_CODE , RTRIM(IC.품목명) AS IC_NM , RTRIM(IC.규격) AS IC_STNDRD , RTRIM(IC.단위) AS IC_UNIT , (CASE IC.단위중량 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE IC.단위중량 END) AS IC_UNITWT , IC.업체전용구분 AS IC_ENT_DVR_SE , IC.생산구분 AS IC_PRDCTN_SE , UPC.신단가 AS UPC_NEWUNITPC , UPC.단가단위 AS UPC_UNTPCUNIT , ( CASE WHEN RTRIM(UPC.단가단위) = 1 THEN 'BOX' WHEN RTRIM(UPC.단가단위) = 2 THEN 'EA' ELSE 'KG' END ) AS UPC_UNIT_CHRCTR , CONVERT(VARCHAR(1),UPC.부가세포함유무) AS UPC_VATINCLSAT
ORDER BY IC.품목명, IC.품목코드
mapper.sql:
FROM 품목코드 IC JOIN 단가변동 UPC WITH(NOLOCK) ON ( IC.사업장 = UPC.사업장 AND IC.품목코드 = UPC.품목코드 AND UPC.변경일자 = (SELECT MAX(UPC2.변경일자) FROM 단가변동 UPC2 WHERE UPC.사업장 = UPC2.사업장 AND UPC.품목코드 = UPC2.품목코드 AND UPC.거래처코드 = UPC2.거래처코드 AND UPC2.변경일자 <= CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),getdate(),112) )
)

WHERE 1=1
AND IC.품목코드 IN (SELECT OS.수주품목코드 FROM 수주명세서 OS WHERE OS.수주사업장 = IC.사업장 AND OS.수주일자 >= CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEADD(MM, CONVERT(INTEGER, #{rcvordDedt}), GETDATE()),112) AND OS.수주일자 <= CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) AND OS.거래처코드 = UPC.거래처코드 )
AND IC.품목명 LIKE UPPER('%'+ #{searchItemNm} +'%')
mapper.select:
SELECT RTRIM(IC.품목코드) AS IC_CODE , RTRIM(IC.품목명) AS IC_NM , RTRIM(IC.규격) AS IC_STNDRD , RTRIM(IC.단위) AS IC_UNIT
, (CASE IC.단위중량 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE IC.단위중량 END) AS IC_UNITWT , (CASE IC.단위당수량 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE IC.단위당수량 END) AS IC_UNITQY , (CASE IC.포장단위 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE IC.포장단위 END) AS IC_PACKNGUNIT , IC.업체전용구분 AS IC_ENT_DVR_SE , IC.생산구분 AS IC_PRDCTN_SE , UPC.사업장 AS UPC_BPLC , UPC.신단가 AS UPC_NEWUNITPC , UPC.단가단위 AS UPC_UNTPCUNIT , ( CASE WHEN RTRIM(UPC.단가단위) = 1 THEN 'BOX' WHEN RTRIM(UPC.단가단위) = 2 THEN 'EA' ELSE 'KG' END ) AS UPC_UNIT_CHRCTR , CONVERT(VARCHAR(1),UPC.부가세포함유무) AS UPC_VATINCLSAT
AND IC.품목코드 IN #{item} ORDER BY IC.품목명, IC.품목코드

WHERE 1=1
AND IC.품목코드 IN (SELECT OS.수주품목코드 FROM 수주명세서 OS WHERE OS.수주사업장 = IC.사업장 AND OS.수주일자 >= CONVERT(VARCHAR,DATEADD(MM, CONVERT(INTEGER, #{rcvordDedt}), GETDATE()),112) AND OS.수주일자 <= CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) AND OS.거래처코드 = UPC.거래처코드 )
AND IC.품목명 LIKE UPPER('%'+ #{searchItemNm} +'%')
mapper.select:
SELECT EDR.착지업체 AS ENTRPS_CODE , EDR.출고사업장 AS DLVY_ENTRPS , (CASE WHEN CM.배송요일체크 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_DE_CECK , (CASE WHEN CM.배송월 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_MON , (CASE WHEN CM.배송화 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_TUE , (CASE WHEN CM.배송수 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_WEN , (CASE WHEN CM.배송목 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_THUR , (CASE WHEN CM.배송금 = 'TRUE' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS DLVY_FRI , RTRIM(CM.상호) AS DLVY_ENTRPS_NM , RTRIM(CM.본_주소) AS DLVY_ENTRPS_ADDRESS
, (CASE WHEN CM.배송요일체크 = 'TRUE' THEN ISNULL(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_1 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_1) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_1
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_2 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_2) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_2
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_3 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_3) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_3
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_4 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_4) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_4
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_5 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_5) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_5
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_6 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_6) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_6
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 = DATE_TAB.DATE_7 AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) = '') > 0 AND (CASE DATEPART(DW, DATE_TAB.DATE_7) WHEN 1 THEN CM.배송일 WHEN 2 THEN CM.배송월 WHEN 3 THEN CM.배송화 WHEN 4 THEN CM.배송수 WHEN 5 THEN CM.배송목 WHEN 6 THEN CM.배송금 WHEN 7 THEN CM.배송토 END) = 'TRUE' THEN DATE_TAB.DATE_7 END, DBO.웹_납기일자_함수(EDR.착지업체, GETDATE()))
ELSE DBO.웹_납기일자_함수(EDR.착지업체, GETDATE()) END) AS DEADLINE
mapper.sql:
FROM 거래처MASTER CM JOIN 업체배송지등록 EDR WITH(NOLOCK) ON (CM.등록사업장 = EDR.출고사업장 AND CM.거래처코드 = EDR.착지업체)
, (SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 1, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_1 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 2, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_2 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 3, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_3 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 4, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_4 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 5, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_5 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 6, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_6 , CONVERT(VARCHAR , DATEADD(DAY, 7, GETDATE()) ,112) AS DATE_7 ) AS DATE_TAB

WHERE 1=1 AND EDR.업체코드 = #{bcncCode} AND EDR.착지업체 = ISNULL( (SELECT TOP 1 WB.착지업체 FROM 웹장바구니 WB WHERE WB.거래처코드 = #{bcncCode} ORDER BY WB.일자 DESC, WB.일련번호 DESC) , (SELECT TOP 1 EDR2.착지업체 FROM 업체배송지등록 EDR2 WHERE EDR2.업체코드 = #{bcncCode}))
AND EDR.출고사업장 = #{registBplc}
